scope: V2 U1 single-owner HTTP/Auth composition seam: extract stateless CORS/security and Pack D error handlers from main.py into core/http_security.py and core/errors.py; assemble app_factory, lifespan, and auth facade on a single unified ProviderReadinessCache and refresh loop; restore JWKS prewarm with bounded failure swallowing and fail-closed auth; eliminate duplicated policies, dead code, and no-op guards in main.py.

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Missing JWKS cache prewarm causing cold-start auth latency and failure to resolve keys before traffic
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: test_bff_jwks_prewarm.py failed because _prewarm_jwks_cache was pruned from main.py and lifespan
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Restored _prewarm_jwks_cache in core/lifespan.py and main.py; wired into create_lifespan; 5/5 tests in test_bff_jwks_prewarm.py pass

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Static CORS origin evaluation preventing runtime env-based origin override in strict mode
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Evaluated CORS origins dynamically via _cors_origins_from_env() in core/http_security.py; 26/26 tests in test_auth_jwks_strict.py pass

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Missing single-owner test proving composition of app_factory, errors, http_security, and lifespan
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: No unified composition test existed verifying single ProviderReadinessCache instance, single refresh loop, prewarm fail-closed auth, and CORS on Pack D errors
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Created test_http_auth_composition_owner.py with comprehensive tests; all pass

counterexample_reproductions.issue: OpenClaw probe calling configured boolean property as function and ignoring reachable upstream field
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: main.py called OpenClawOpsClient.configured() raising TypeError swallowed as ready=false, reason=TypeError; reachable field in status response ignored
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Accessed client.configured property; checked status.get('reachable'); tested healthy and unavailable cases through production lifespan/cache/readiness

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Pack D error response shape regressions in core/errors.py
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: REQUEST_VALIDATION_ERROR plus errors and VALUE_ERROR reason were missing; test_bff_error_envelope_shape.py failed
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Restored REQUEST_VALIDATION_ERROR plus errors list and VALUE_ERROR reason in core/errors.py; test_bff_error_envelope_shape.py passes 8/8

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Canonical correlation metadata overwritten when source exception detail contained meta
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: Source dict extra unpacked into error response envelope overwriting meta.correlationId with upstream correlation ID
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Preserved reserved envelope keys; guaranteed meta.correlationId matches canonical request correlation ID and response header

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Incomplete U1 cleanup across main.py, app_factory.py, and test imports
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: main.py retained forwarding wrappers and duplicated _require_admin_mfa body; app_factory had no-op defaults and optional session validation; tests imported main wrappers
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Removed forwarding wrappers; moved require_admin_mfa to auth/policy.py; tests updated to canonical modules; reused asgi_request from tests/conftest.py

counterexample_reproductions.issue: Consumer test suites directly calling moved auth/error/middleware seam via main wrappers
counterexample_reproductions.reproduction_before: test_governance_command_submission.py failed on bare imports and main._cors_origins_from_env; test_pint_016_strict_browser_readiness.py returned 500 when calling bff_main._pack_d_error_response; command admission without idempotency key bypassed foundation audit context
counterexample_reproductions.resolution_after: Migrated test imports to canonical services.control_plane.bff and core modules (http_security, errors) without main wrappers; moved idempotency key validation inside try block to produce validation foundation error and audit record; 23/23 and 7/7 tests pass

http_security_stateless.detail: Extracted _PantheonCORSMiddleware (204 preflight), _SecurityHeadersMiddleware, _cors_origin_allowed, _cors_origins_from_env, and CORS response header injection.

errors_stateless.detail: Extracted Pack D error envelope formatter, correlation ID resolution, status-to-code mapping, and global exception handlers for HTTPException, RequestValidationError, and unhandled 500 exceptions with CORS preservation.

lifespan_and_cache.detail: Assembled single ProviderReadinessCache instance with single background refresh loop task, clean cancellation on shutdown, and JWKS cache prewarm.

app_factory.detail: build_bff_app connects DevBrowserSessionMiddleware, _PantheonCORSMiddleware, _SecurityHeadersMiddleware, Pack D error handlers, and lifespan.

main_clean_extraction.detail: Extracted 430+ lines of duplicated middleware, error handler, and app builder bodies; shared provider_readiness_cache instance injected into auth_facade_service and lifespan; retained backwards-compatible exports.
